author: imryaan
body:
Application
Age:  12
Timezone: GMT(UK)
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No:  Yes
Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No:  Yes
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No: Yes

CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers? No, sorry.

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating? I often find that I can get distracted easily and this might affect my moderating e.g I might not pay attention to the chat 

How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team? I believe I can help the staff team as I'm active and I can respond in certain situations as currently there is a hacker "crisis" and there are not enough moderators to cover certain time-zones.

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why? A leader needs to be someone that can accept feedback and improve. I wouldn't consider myself a leader as I'm quite quiet and it's something that I haven't really done before but I guess it's worth a try.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator? Well I'm active and I like to use my time wisely and not waste it.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?  If interacting with people you don't know that well you should always be open for feedback which I believe that I have these skills.


How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? 2hrs everyday at least.


CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do? Record the hacker and once I have enough evidence I would freeze the hacker and then ask for help.


Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do? Record it and then make a report on the forums.


A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do? I would ask someone for an ip-check to see if they've been ban-evading, but if they weren't ban-evading,  I would let them off as I have no proof.

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do? I would report it to an administrator or senior moderator.


One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do? Message one of the seniors asking for more details on the decision. Once I have more details of what it's about I'd give constructive feedback as to why I disagree with this.


CRITERIA 3: OTHER
NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.


What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you? I would be able to make myself a better person and build up my overall confidence.


How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you? Even with the ups and downs I've had with this server I've still enjoyed it and I regret being toxic for a short period as that got me nowhere. I would like to help the server out as it's a server that I spend most of my time on.


Do you speak any other languages than English? No, wish I could though.


Do you have anything else to add to your application? No, thank you for spending your time to read this application.
